comps.name: Dragons - APM Evoker
comps.guide_text: [[Fire-Forged Evoker||120301]] scales with the amount of spells you cast. Your spell generation comes from casting bounties with [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] and [[Proud Privateer||122520]]. Must be infinite with this comp, may use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] to help achieve that. Cycle every cheap card ([[River Skipper||122092]]) to spend gold and stay infinite. Leave [[Persistent Poet||108463]] on your board to capture permanent stats from Evoker. The best dragon to scale is [[Warpwing||92413]]. Get permanent divine shield and windfury on it using [[Amber guardian||95006]] and [[Thousandth Paper Drake||108116]] to end on in a turn.

comps.name: Demons - APM Shop Buff
comps.guide_text: You must have an insane amount of economy to go for this comp. This is usually achieved with a turn 9 Brann + Rogers + Privateer. When you have too much economy, you will buy all targeted spells to use on [[Devilish Distractor||132901]] + [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] to scale the shop. You may also buff the shop cycling bloom gem buffers and buying every gem barrage card. You'll also generate a ton of spells by being infinite, allowing [[Felboar||110664]] or [[Twisted Wrathguard||130662]] to eat a huge shop over and over again. Brann and Escapee are additional tools to be infinite.

comps.name: Undead - APM Undead
comps.guide_text: [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] combined with [[Proud Privateer||122520]] gives you lots of gold to hit more of your setup.  Additional cards that help you become infinite include [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] and [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], but can be cut once you commit more undeads to your board. Cycle every single free card ([[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]]) so you stay infinite. After you're infinite, scale undead attack using bounties + [[Forsaken Weaver||126733]]. Run a reborn golden [[Handless Forsaken||95265]] to be strong. Also use [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] and cycle every single destroy undead effect such as [[Maw Caster||121508]] and [[Disguised Graverobber||104610]] to destroy reborns and give snazzy permanent stats.

guide_sections.when_to_commit: Bounty Generation ([[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]]) + [[Proud Privateer||122520]] + [[Forsaken Weaver||126733]]

comps.name: Undead - Attack Scaling
comps.guide_text: Scale the attack of your Undeads and summons with the Butchering spell from [[Drustfallen Butcher||120104]]. Butchering spell improves with spell scaling from [[Friendly Geist||120219]]. Your quality of summons come from [[Handless Forsaken||95265]]. [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] provides a ton of attack and health to your right most unit in combat, but also during the shop phase. Start using Butchering spells on your reborn cards with [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] on board to capture permanent stats. The best variation of this comp is to run [[Dead Bellringer||132322]] + [[Mummifier||108992]] to first reborn your entire board. Then, with a full hand of butchering and also Snazzy, use bellringer activate on the mummifier, then the bellringer will get reborn, and then butcher the bellringer, and repeat for all your butchering spells. This'll give you an insane amount of Snazzy procs.

comps.name: Dragons - Battlecries
comps.guide_text: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Kalecgos, Arcane Aspect||60630]] gives all of your dragons +4/4 every single battlecry you play. You want to trigger as many battlecries as possible. After you have your setup, cycle only PREMIUM battlecries, such as [[Tavern Tempest||64077]], [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]], [[Shell Collector||80740]] or [[Draconic Warden||126860]]. The highest cap is to find as many double attack spell every turn, and permanently double the attack of warpwing every turn with the help of [[Persistent Poet||108463]]. Additionally, permanently attach divine shield with [[Amber Guardian||95006]] and permanently attach Windfury on Warpwing with [[Thousandth Paper Drake||108116]].

comps.name: Quilboar - Bristlemane
comps.guide_text: First, have gems scaled, usually with early [[Gem Rat||116434]]. Then, use [[Vigilant Bristlemane||132320]] to cast gems on the most premium card which is [[Blade Collector||99035]] or any premium dark gifts. Balinda is crucial to double Bristemane's effect. Concentrate all your gems on your juggernaut every turn using your Gem Confiscation from [[Trench Fighter||126671]]. In the endgame, starting filling out your board with ending units such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].

comps.name: Nagas - End Of Turn/Spell Buff
comps.guide_text: [[Felfire Conjurer||120299]] buffs your spell power, while [[Fauna Whisperer||120905]] uses that spell power to buff your board at the end of the turn. Both effects are amplified by [[Drakkari Enchanter||101314]]. The best target to buff with [[Fauna Whisperer||120905]] is [[Gatekeeper Amalgam||133329]] because it is an all tribe which buffs all your tribed units, and also it additionally casts Misplaced Tea Sets which benefit from spell power. Buy cheap targetted spells to use on Amalgam when you have [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]].

comps.name: Murlocs - Family
comps.guide_text: Generate [[Papa Mrrglton||131147]] or [[Mama Mrrglton||131145]] early on with [[Cousin Errgl||131149]]. Use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] to double the effect of all of these battlecries. Could choose to buff premium murlocs such as [[Bile Spitter||122219]] or [[Expert Aviator||126637]] that can summon scam units.

comps.guide_text: Put targetted spells on mechs as much as possible with [[Glambot||132893]] on board. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles the effect. comps.name: Demons - Self Damage
comps.guide_text: The idea of this comp is to use effects such as [[Malchezaar, Prince of Dance||99199]], [[Wrath Weaver||59670]], or trinkets to deal damage to your hero, and [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] to negate this damage. [[Tichondrius||99228]] is some payoff for self damage, and used to stabilize in the midgame. Cupcakes generation with [[Eredar Escapist||133028]] is your main payoff for the lategame, targetting [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] to buff your shop. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles the effect of both Cupcakes and [[Devilish Distractor||132901]]. With [[Wrath Weaver||59670]], every single Demon played makes your next spell free which generates a ton of value. The best demon generation is from [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] and cycling [[Imposing Percussionist||99232]].

guide_sections.when_to_commit: [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] + self damage ([[Wrath Weaver||59670]] or [[Malchezaar, Prince of Dance||99199]]) + payoff ([[Tichondrius||99228]] or [[Eredar Escapist||133028]])

comps.name: Beasts - Summons
comps.guide_text: First, have [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] in the midgame to start generating many beasts and along the way, generate the core pieces to this comp. Then, proc [[Goldrinn, the Great Wolf||59955]] during shop phase with the help of [[Deathstrider||132808]]. [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] also doubles the effectiveness of this strategy. Force your Gryphon to attack using [[Lurking Lionfish||132794]] activate or cycling [[Snarky Shark||132804]]. Best case is when you chain shop attacks by generating more Lionfish and Sharks. Then, use [[Sewer Lord||130996]] and [[Banana Slamma||98824]] to benefit from the aura from Goldrinn and summon huge attack beasts.

Reborn taunt your lobster, and then windfury your Gryphon with [[Sprightly Scarab||108909]].

Paired with [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]], play as many spells on the tidecaller as possible, which could be bloodgems or [[Oozeling Gladiator||103670]] spells. Scale premium murlocs in hand such as [[Bile Spitter||122219]] and [[Expert Aviator||126637]] so you can summon them and also [[Choral Mrrrglr||98948]] can capture all of the stats of the murlocs in your hand.

guide_sections.how_to_build: First, have a ton of economy, typically starting from golden [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or Brann + [[Magicfin Mycologist||122277]], remembering premium economy spells such as Cloning Conch or Battlecry Discovery. Then, your payoff card for all that economy is [[Shamanic Tidecaller||133026]]. Paired with [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]], play as many spells on the tidecaller as possible, which could be bloodgems or [[Oozeling Gladiator||103670]] spells. Scale premium murlocs in hand such as [[Bile Spitter||122219]] and [[Expert Aviator||126637]] so you can summon them and also [[Choral Mrrrglr||98948]] can capture all of the stats of the murlocs in your hand.

comps.name: Elementals - Unbound Tempest
comps.guide_text: Buff the shop with either [[Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare||63626]] or [[Air Revenant||126173]], whichever method you find first. Use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Tavern Tempest||64077]] + [[Kelp Keeper||132883]] for massive economy and elemental generation. You may use [[Flaming Enforcer||126924]] to stabilize in the midgame, and [[Unbound Tempest||132983]] to cap out your scaling. With tempest, cycle premium elementals such as [[Sellemental||64038]] and [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]].

guide_sections.when_to_commit: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + shop buff ([[Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare||63626]]) + [[Unbound Tempest||132983]]

comps.name: Murlocs - Venom Scam
comps.guide_text: Buy all the scam cards and try to preserve placements by killing as many units as possible. Keep your strongest units on the board (that's why you want to concentrate stats!) and fill the rest of the board with units that may be able to trade 1 for 1. Aim to golden [[Expert Aviator||126637]] and give it venom using [[Bile Spitter||122219]]. Then, the Aviator will pull many scam units from your hand. Could give murlocs permanent Venom using [[Sky-hatch Runaway||132957]] as well.

comps.name: Aberrations - Discard Engine
comps.guide_text: Aberrations win early–mid by discarding fodder to pump your Deity and board, then often pivot rather than forcing a pure late Aberration endgame. Key enablers: Activate discard pieces (Zoatroid, Abyssal Envoy, Mindbending Recruiter) plus hand generators; Blood Gems are excellent discard fuel. Mindbender Ghur'sha is the board-wide payoff on every discard; Cutthroat K'Thir and Harbinger Aph'lass stack Deity/self stats; The Shadow of Doubt scales whenever cards enter hand. Turn plan: keep a discard Activate ready, generate cheap cards/spells, discard into Mindbender Ghur'sha/Cutthroat K'Thir/Harbinger Aph'lass, and improve spell power with Dark Puppeteer / N'raqi Frostcaller. Late: Parasitic Fleshling and Mysterious K'Thir convert total discards/spells into stats; De-volition-ist is the attack finisher. Do not plan around Tier-7.

comps.name: Dragons - Rally Poet
comps.guide_text: Classic Dragons APM Evoker is dead this lobby (Fire-Forged Evoker / key discover pieces out of pool) — play Rally + permanent-keyword dragons instead. Park Persistent Poet beside your carry (Crimson Vindicator or Scarlet Survivor/Tarecgosa) so combat keywords and stats stick forever; Amber Guardian attaches permanent Divine Shield through Poet. Hunt Chromadrake generators (Draconic Warden, Bronze Timewalker, Hired Mount) and Sky-hatch Runaway to force Rally triggers on demand; Crimson Vindicator's Rally casts Mighty Dragonbreath for the combat spike. Kalecgos, Arcane Aspect (+ Brann Bronzebeard if available) rewards battlecry cycling (Draconic Warden, Tavern Tempest, Firescale Hoarder). Felfire Conjurer / Firescale Hoarder drip permanent tavern-spell buffs. Do not draft around Tier-7 Obsidian Ravager.

comps.name: Elementals - Unbound Tempest
comps.guide_text: Elementals Unbound Tempest is still the scaling plan: buff the shop, then feed Unbound Tempest the highest-Health tavern minion every three Elementals played. Nomi is out of pool — Air Revenant (Easterly Winds after gold) and En-Djinn Blazer / Waveling refresh buffs are the shop enablers. Economy engine: Brann Bronzebeard + Tavern Tempest + Kelp Keeper to chain Elemental battlecries and stay infinite; cycle Sellemental, Refreshing Anomaly, and Ballers. Flaming Enforcer stabilizes mid by consuming tavern Health; Flourishing Frostling is a passive payoff for Elementals played this game; Elemental of Surprise helps triple awkwardly. Do not plan around Tier-7 Stone Age Slab.

comps.name: Mechs - Glambot Magnetics
comps.guide_text: Mechs Magnetics/Spells: while Glambot is on board, every spell cast on a Mech Magnetizes a Satellite; Balinda Stonehearth doubles targeted friendly spells so you attach twice as often. Spark Snapper improves Satellite size whenever you play Mechs (Scrap Scraper is out — Snapper is the generation core). Drone Duplicator Activate makes the next Magnetize happen an extra time. Endgame Utility Drone pays +4/+5 per Magnetization at end of turn — that is the win condition. Charging Czarina spikes Divine Shield mechs when you cast spells. Turn plan: buy 1–2 cost targeted spells / Fearless Foodie / Gearfin spell gen, cast onto mechs, Activate Duplicator on the best Magnetize, then land Utility Drone. Optional deathrattle line: Falling Sky Golem + Titus Rivendare if magnetics are slow. No Tier-7 Polarizing Beatboxer.

comps.name: Quilboar - Choose One Gems
comps.guide_text: Quilboar Choose One: scale Blood Gem quality first (Gem Rat's Gem Day, Fearless Foodie +1/+1 choose, Sanguine Refiner Rally, Sanguine Champion battlecry/deathrattle), then pay off with Turbo Hogrider. Every Choose One you play makes Turbo Hogrider blood-gem all other Quilboar — generate Choose Ones via Bramble Tunneler, Gem Rat, Snare Trapper, Crater Miner; Thorned Trailblazer combines both Choose effects. Veteran Brigand is the late Choose One bomb (gems everyone or triple Barrage). Trench Fighter's Gem Confiscation concentrates gems onto one unit when you need a carry. Meta: Quilboar are often support (Blood Gems for spell-on-minion comps or Aberration discard fodder) — force pure Quilboar when the lobby is soft or you hit Hogrider + gem quality early. No Tier-7 Jailbird Juggernaut; Vigilant Bristlemane is out of pool.
